abah: noun 1. (a black river bird) 2. (mango): abahthai (mango fruit); abah bang (mango tree)
abaw: noun (a , Megalaimidae: green singing bird that can pack hole in tree for laying egg)
abay e: verb; noun abaymei (fight with hands): Kaney abay e. (They hit each other.)
achaic: noun (my elder brother/sister): Kamei achaic e. (He/she is my elder brother/sister.)
achaicbung: noun (my elder brother): Kamei achaicbung e. (He is my elder brother.)
achaiclu: noun (my elder sister): Kamei achaiclu e. (She is my elder sister.)
achana: noun (my brother, within man): Kamei achana e. (He is my brother.)
achaw: noun (a species of rodent; big field rat)
achow e: adverb; noun achowmei (facing): Kaney dungc achow e. (They sit facing each other.)
achuanh: noun (fisher-man): John hei achuanh khwan e. (John was a fisherman.)
adangv e: verb; noun adangvmei (responsive): Kaniw lu suan adangv e. (They sing responsively.)
